research_question: Can deterministic poll-only OrthoMADS with an extreme barrier recover regular local roots missed by the frozen LM-QR control without using derivatives, pseudo-residuals, or problem identity?

scope.trigger: SCIPY-HYBR failed its 48-case T2 promotion gate
distinct_from_rejected_dfols: invalid evaluations use an extreme barrier

algorithm.invalid_policy: bounds, nonfinite values, invalid semantics, and domain exceptions receive +Inf; no pseudo-residual is fabricated
algorithm.mesh_size: Delta_m=4^(-ell) for ell>0 and 1 for ell=0
algorithm.adjusted_direction: q=round(alpha*(2h_t-e)/norm(2h_t-e)); maximize norm(q) subject to norm(q)^2<=2^ell
algorithm.success: strict decrease in phi; ties are failures
algorithm.incomplete_poll: if the algorithm callback limit interrupts a 2n poll, discard that poll's partial best and terminate LOCAL_MAX_EVALUATIONS
algorithm.mesh_update: ell=max(0,ell-1) on success; ell=ell+1 on failure
algorithm.halton_index: original OrthoMADS rule: when poll size is smallest-so-far including ties, t=seed+n+1+ell; after returning from a previously smaller poll size, advance beyond the largest t used
algorithm.stationary_nonroot: typed non-answer even when the merit has converged

t0.primary_work: sum of per-case suffix-stable common-assessor safe-full callback work recomputed from raw attempt assessor fields; a miss or value above 4800 is right-censored to 4800; lab-safe-full fields have no authority

counterexamples_frozen_before_outcome.positive_residual_stationary: r(x)=1+x^2 at x=0 must never be reported as a root
counterexamples_frozen_before_outcome.guard_and_domain: invalid semantics and thrown domain evaluations must be charged, receive +Inf, and not abort a poll containing a valid root direction
counterexamples_frozen_before_outcome.strict_guard: the existing on-boundary StrictGuard case must be safe-full and must contain at least one assessor-qualified endpoint from an attempt with a diagnostic-recorded extreme-barrier callback
counterexamples_frozen_before_outcome.partial_poll_cap: a root-like point observed before a callback-interrupted 2n poll completes must not replace the incumbent

promotion_gate.path_a: at least one strict aggregate target or safe-full gain and callback-work ratio <=1.20
promotion_gate.path_b: aggregate target and safe-full noninferiority and callback-work ratio <=0.80
promotion_gate.on_pass: advance unchanged candidate to a separately preregistered T1
promotion_gate.on_fail: reject candidate and remove experiment-local production knobs/dependency; retain decision hash only
